tools.name: gaip_check
tools.description: Use this when asked whether an AI agent, MCP server or API works or has changed, e.g. before adding or paying it. Pass its `url`. Returns a verdict, fixes, dated history when observed, and a receipt. With `agent` (e.g. GPTBot): may your bot fetch it (robots.txt, AI-crawler rules)? Free, read-only, n

tools.name: gaip_watch
tools.description: Use this when asked to keep an eye on an agent or MCP server, or to be alerted when it changes. Pass its `url`: returns feed links and its latest dated changes; add `webhook_url` for a free watch (checked every 24 h, signed webhook on change). Free, no account; with a webhook it records a watch. Inp

tools.name: gaip_diagnose
tools.description: Use this when an agent, MCP or API call failed. Paste the `error` text and/or `http_status`; add the service `url` if known. Returns the cause, the exact fix (e.g. the missing argument) and retry_after_seconds; `keep_receipt: true` adds a dated receipt. Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be pu

tools.name: gaip_verify
tools.description: Use this when asked whether a service delivered what was promised or whether cited pages contain the quoted text. Pass `citations`, or a service `url` (+ `checks`, the `result` you got), or `claims` with `observations`. Returns a result per item. Free, no account; only delivery keeps a record. Input

tools.name: second_look_check
tools.description: Use this when a shopper is about to buy something an AI suggested, or asks if a price or stock claim is right. Pass the product page `url` and the `claim`. Returns what the page showed beside what the claim said, and a signed, dated receipt. Second Look by GAIP. Free, no account, no affiliate links;

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gaip_check, gaip_diagnose, second_look_check · Private data: gaip_watch, gaip_verify · Public sink: gaip_watch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gaip_check, gaip_diagnose, second_look_check · Private data: gaip_watch, gaip_verify · Public sink: gaip_watch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
